References: Image 1 is the exact original and is authoritative for this pose, camera, expression and silhouette. Image 2 is the approved Johnny character identity sheet. Preserve the asymmetry and tall diagonal jump silhouette, two connected legs and arms, not a symmetrical star jump.
Identity/style: lean lanky castaway, long rounded nose, shaggy dark brown hair, full scruffy dark beard, white sailor cap with projecting black brim, narrow gold band and black anchor, ragged white shorts, bare feet. Clean confident black cartoon outlines, warm lighter peach skin, controlled cel shading matching the approved references. The original's red checkerboard pixels are diagnostic skin, not clothing or pattern.
Composition: entire cap, fingers and feet visible, centered with ample transparent padding. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Omit original gray ground shadow. No scenery, floor, text, panel layout or extra pose. Only the single requested sprite.
